ul.li: zone names unique; conduits only between known zones
every conduit restricts protocols and ports (no any/any)
no conduit skips a Purdue level unless it ends in the DMZ
conduits into a zone with SL-T ≥ 3 must be encrypted
the model fails to load if any rule is broken (fail closed)
